scope:
Audit actual callers across the disruptive cohesion revision.

Imports the strict ELF64 parser from cohesion-codegen.py. Only documented,
side-aware demangled API role/type correspondences are normalized. Every emitted
instruction/data byte, relocation offset/kind/value/addend remains literal.
Differences are findings to inspect, not failures to normalize away.

limits: Unlinked ELF object audit with assertions enabled, not timings or a linked-placement guarantee. Function names are paired only by the explicit correspondences; literal code/data bytes, immediates, assertion text, relocations and unknown targets are preserved. Full functions include admission/effects, but only the listed callers are sampled. Changed and unmatched work remains visible. Native five-trial counterbalanced cohorts, with per-case dispersion, qualify measured complete consumers separately; neither code size nor one timing sample establishes a general speed claim.

source_capture.note: The native before adds only its recorded TP point oracle/reset harness patch. All before Ikea files in this object audit are exact Git f1534200. After Ikea is exactly the r2 native capture cut, including the dense AVX512 std::byte boundary fix.

dependency_digests.algorithm: SHA256 of UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys and compact separators, mapping dependency path to SHA256. Project paths relative to the arm source root; system paths literal. Full system list remains in ignored receipt.json.

dense_bridge_fix.meaning: The cast enables previously failing AVX512 dense-word template instantiations. It changes no emitted byte in these selected actual TUs. Full-scope tiles_1/9/25/57 syntax passes separately; this is not a claim that the previously uninstantiable path had a before object.

inspected_observations.subject: SeriesPack compiled physical readers
inspected_observations.finding: All 490 function bodies, relocations and constants per profile match exactly after the recorded role/type correspondences. This covers compiled dense and placed callbacks; typed caller admission/lifetime code is also inspected in the ordinary examples, but not inferred free from this callback match.

inspected_observations.subject: SeriesPack ordinary and owner integration
inspected_observations.finding: Mutation/admission/effects functions have real differences, plus unmatched private adapter/template signatures. Source-qualified journal identities are the caller-named view while traversal copies metadata. These complete drivers remain runtime qualification subjects; the audit makes no blanket unchanged-code claim.

inspected_observations.subject: Filter composition exercise<12> and exercise<15>
inspected_observations.finding: Complete operation sequences and function sizes match on all profiles; four assertion line immediates advance by one per function. Literal assertion strings, names and targets remain unnormalized differences.

inspected_observations.subject: TuplePack words and initialization plan
inspected_observations.finding: The complete words example main and compiled initialization-plan make function are exact on all three profiles.

inspected_observations.subject: TuplePack writer<128>::set_unchecked journal specialization
inspected_observations.finding: Full example-emitted functions preserve source-qualified effects, copy the first input64, conditionally copy the second input64 when count>=65, memset destination, then issue one and conditionally two existing write_buffered calls. No old destination read occurs before initialization. NEON size280->292 B/static instructions70->73/frame160->176 B, with one more saved register and split mul/add. AVX2 size341->370 B/static instructions86->93; AVX512327->362 B/82->89; both x86 profiles save rbp and spill two coalescing-path temporaries. These are register-pressure/address-arithmetic risks, not measured losses; whole-command64/65/128-code checked/trusted trials assess them.

inspected_observations.subject: TuplePack filter integration
inspected_observations.finding: The actual checked predicate complete bodies retain their native predicate paths but add scalar load/address work: NEON equality and >= examples8676->8692 B each; AVX2 equality9066->9103 B and >=9126->9159 B. The surrounding ordinary example also changes admission. Complete filter consumers, including tight/shifted/strided layouts and active masks, require runtime qualification; no free-wrapper assumption is made.

inspected_observations.subject: TuplePack ordinary main
inspected_observations.finding: Same function size on each profile; the NEON instruction-only difference is the overflow error value7->8 after adding effects to the enum. Changed literal values and relocation/diagnostic labels remain in strict differences.

inspected_observations.subject: Hashtable ordinary owner
inspected_observations.finding: All30 NEON,32 AVX2 and27 AVX512 corresponding functions have identical instruction bytes, including complete main, insert_slow payloads, growth and admission. Two constructor relocation records per profile retain differently named compiler-generated attach.used data targets; constant bytes are equal. Raw mangled fragments are not rewritten.

inspected_observations.subject: Bec ordinary and bitset bridge
inspected_observations.finding: The little-endian bridge introduces no runtime endian-mode branch. Ordinary main grows740->748 B NEON,885->921 B AVX2 and882->908 B AVX512: singleton construction stores differ and bitset256 default-zero initialization clears the decoded output before its complete decode. This setup cost is retained. Maintained recurring decode uses an output buffer created before its timed loop; supplemental native trials assess complete recurring consumers separately.

inspected_observations.subject: StreamPack ordinary
inspected_observations.finding: Complete main instruction bytes are identical on every profile, with changed relocation names. AVX2/AVX512 compact initialize journal specializations add one zero-extension instruction after loading a byte size, with shifted branch offsets; journal coalescing paths and memcpy/memset calls otherwise retain the inspected instruction sequence. Initialization is still part of complete-command cost.

inspected_observations.subject: Selection
inspected_observations.finding: The selection check TU is after-only evidence, never counted as a before/after win. Existing actual Hashtable consumer instruction bytes remain unchanged, supplying a consumer check for the shared selection/bitset bridge.

inspected_observations.subject: Unmatched identifiers
inspected_observations.finding: Clang21 demangles several newly constrained template parameter uses as T/T& while old signatures print the concrete journal type. Stream append visitors and the TP128 journal specialization are left unmatched in strict pairing. SP private physical adapter signatures also genuinely differ; no generic T& substitution or forced100% equality is used.
